notes:
- Company: mid-market product analytics SaaS; search + recommendations are core product features.
- Current stack: Elastic + in-house sparse + dense retriever. Reranking is custom light MLP; want to replace with model-based reranker for better relevance.
- Wants to start on Hosted API to iterate quickly, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable latency/cost once model & evals stabilise. Quote: "Need a repeatable rerank endpoint we can test against our labeled sets and compare offline metrics."
- Requirements: rerank endpoint that accepts top-K candidates, returns scores + explanations (structured tokens), offline scoring (bulk mode) for nightly evals. Prefer a batch/offline scoring API in addition to real-time endpoint.
- Performance targets: p95 latency <= 120ms for k=20 in real-time; throughput ~150 qps burst; offline scoring throughput preferred at 5k+ docs/min for nightly jobs.
- Model pref: open LLM family (Llama2-style), Redwood-verified variants, quantized 4-bit ok for Dedicated. Need quality baselines vs current MLP reranker.
- Eval plan: 2k labeled queries, compare NDCG@10 / MRR / CTR predicted uplift. SE to run baseline vs Redwood reranker and share CI-agnostic report.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics beat cloud GPU costs by >=25% at their projected scale.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs, EU data residency for EU customers (they have EU tenants).
